title: SWREDU=1 Black evaporation reduction production admission

independent_equation_trace.purpose: Independent trace only. Canonical B1.11 manifests and PPA-WU04 review remain admission authority.

frozen_science.wetting_reset: An explicit forcing event resets trial-local ldwet to zero before the dry-trial equation. No hidden calendar-day inference.
frozen_science.ponded_branch: A ponded trial uses potential pond evaporation through the existing top-boundary owner and resets candidate ldwet to zero.
frozen_science.mass_ownership: empreva and ldwet are not water-mass owners. Accepted actual surface evaporation remains owned by the hydraulic dynamic-top boundary.
frozen_science.rollback: Rejected hydraulic trials discard candidate ldwet. Changed-dt retry is recomputed from the same committed ldwet checkpoint.

architecture_binding.process_state_rule: LDWET remains a distinct physical/process continuation component and is not inserted as a hydraulic state field or worker scratch.
architecture_binding.transaction_state: Introduce one option-discriminated composite FMR transaction-state family carrying the existing hydraulic state plus a distinct Black process-state component.
architecture_binding.top_boundary: Reuse the admitted F-SI29/F-SI30 dynamic-top provider/solver interface. Bind it inside each serialized model trial using that trial's t0/t1 and Black demand derived from the transaction checkpoint.
architecture_binding.retry: Dynamic-top request and Black demand are rebuilt for every transaction trial span. No pre-resolved full-interval top flux is reused after dt reduction.
architecture_binding.forcing: Carry explicit raw surface forcing required by Black/dynamic-top evaluation in a bounded optional forcing component. Existing fixed-flux forcing remains byte-semantically unchanged when Black is inactive.
architecture_binding.application: Extend only the PPA-WU01/WU03 production composition needed to initialize SWREDU=1 state and map admitted WU03 forcing into the optional Black forcing component.
architecture_binding.restart: Reuse generic FMR committed restart cloning with a new explicit optional-state-layout identity. Restore must reject BASE/SWREDU=1 layout mismatch.
architecture_binding.solver_policy: No Richards equations, Newton/Jacobian logic, retry policy, solver selection, RossFast internals or coupling semantics may change.
